lines: 一把剑，悬在她的指尖前。
One sword hovers at her fingertips.
剑诀一起，第二把、第一百把、|第一万把，从云海里升起来。
She forms the seal, and a second, a hundredth,|a ten-thousandth sword rise out of the clouds.
一万把剑，每一把都要飞、要躲、要出手。|游戏要怎么算？
Ten thousand swords, and every one has to fly, dodge and strike.|How does a game compute that?
终章，我们把前四期的招式，合成一套御剑术。
For the finale, we combine the moves of the last four episodes into one art of sword flight.
剑群的飞行，就是第一期的鸟群算法。
The swords fly with the flocking algorithm from episode one.
每把剑只看身边最近的几把：|太近就分开，方向和同伴对齐，|再加一股绕着她旋转的力。
Each sword looks only at its nearest few:|too close, move apart; match your neighbours' heading;|and add one more force that circles around her.
三条局部规则，就转出了一道升天的剑旋风。|找邻居，用的还是那张空间网格。
Three local rules spin up a whirlwind of swords.|Neighbours are still found with the same spatial grid.
敌人来了：六千把赤红飞剑。
Then the enemy arrives: six thousand crimson swords.
每把剑都是一个实体：|位置、速度、角色、目标、弯曲，|各存一列数组。
Every sword is an entity:|position, velocity, role, target, bend,|each stored as its own array column.
角色系统分配任务：|有的直取敌人本体，有的去截击来剑，|剩下的在她身前结成剑盾。
A role system hands out jobs:|some go straight for the enemy, some intercept incoming swords,|and the rest form a shield in front of her.
每一帧，系统挨个扫过这些数组。
Each frame, the systems sweep through those arrays one by one.
两把剑相撞时，碰撞系统算出撞击的方向和力度，|写进弯曲组件。
When two swords collide, the collision system works out the direction and force of the hit|and writes them into the bend component.
真正把剑压弯的是顶点着色器：|越靠近剑尖弯得越多，|再叠一段衰减的正弦，就是撞击后的颤动。
The bending itself happens in the vertex shader:|the closer to the tip, the more it bends,|and a decaying sine wave on top is the ringing after the hit.
和第二期《ABZÛ》让鱼身摆动，是同一招。
It's the same trick ABZÛ uses to make a fish's body swim, from episode two.
一万六千把剑，CPU 每帧只上传位置、方向和弯曲，|每把六十四个字节。
Sixteen thousand swords: each frame the CPU uploads only position, direction and bend,|sixty-four bytes per sword.
剑尖朝哪、剑身怎么转，|交给顶点着色器去算。
Which way the tip points and how the blade turns|are left to the vertex shader.
所有剑一次绘制，剑光和火花各再加一次。
All the swords take one draw call, plus one each for the trails and the sparks.
她剑诀前推。
She drives the seal forward.
一万把剑同时转向，汇成一条剑河，|击碎对方的护体剑气。
Ten thousand swords turn at once, merging into a river of blades|that shatters the enemy's guarding aura.
被打弯的红剑，一把把坠进云海。
The bent red swords drop, one by one, into the sea of clouds.
收剑。
Sheathe.
弯掉的剑在归途上慢慢回直，|每一把都回到它出发的位置。
On the way back, the bent swords slowly straighten,|and each one returns to exactly where it set out.
五期下来：局部规则、空间网格、|实例化和顶点动画、数据和逻辑分开，|再把能算的交给 GPU。
Five episodes: local rules, a spatial grid,|instancing and vertex animation, data kept apart from logic,|and everything computable handed to the GPU.
一只鸟、一条鱼、一个僵尸、一块板、一把剑，|变成一万个，用的是同一套办法。
A bird, a fish, a zombie, a panel, a sword:|turning one into ten thousand takes the same set of moves.
而这一切，都从一把剑开始。
And all of it begins with a single sword.
